messages:
PagerDutyBot: Alert: multiple services reporting SSL/TLS handshake failures -> elevated 5xx from edge gateways (error_rate > 3% over 5m). Paging Priya (oncall).
Priya (oncall): saw the pager, jumping in. Which region? any customer impact?
Connor (infra): EU-edge first, saw spike ~10:12 UTC. 502/524 from fronting gateways, backend appears healthy.
Miguel (svc-owner): customers on EU cluster reporting API errors and failed connections. Support already has a small wave of tickets.
Julie (support): confirming: multiple paying customers reported immediate errors when calling the generation API, 100% failure for a subset for ~15m.
Priya (oncall): ok. Connor can you paste the gateway logs? need TLS handshake errors specifically.
Connor (infra): logs snippet:
```
2026-03-15T10:11:43Z gateway-1 ssl_handshake.c: failed verify:certificate expired (depth=1)
2026-03-15T10:11:43Z gateway-1 ssl_handshake.c: SSL_do_handshake() failed: TLSV1_ALERT_UNKNOWN_CA
2026-03-15T10:12:01Z gateway-2 ssl_handshake.c: peer cert expired: subject=/CN=redwood-eu-int
```
Priya (oncall): looks like an intermediate cert expired (depth=1). Might be the intermediate used for mTLS or client validation. Was there a recent rotation?
Miguel (svc-owner): we rolled a new leaf cert last week but didn't touch the intermediate. CI/CD for cert rotation should be separate. I didn't get alerts for intermediate expiry.
Evan (SRE): running `openssl s_client -connect eu-gateway.redwood.internal:443 -showcerts -servername eu-gateway` shows the chain and an expired intermediate (not the leaf). quick output:
```
$ openssl s_client -connect eu-gateway.redwood.internal:443 -showcerts
---
subject=/CN=redwood-eu
issuer=/CN=redwood-eu-int
verify error:num=10:certificate has expired
notAfter=Mar 14 09:00:00 2026 GMT
```
Julie (support): customers impacted include two enterprise tenants on EU region (account IDs masked in tickets). Prioritizing P1 outreach.
Priya (oncall): mitigation plan proposals: 1) temporarily route traffic to global-backup region (latency hit) 2) re-upload a valid intermediate from our vault to edge (faster but risk config mismatch) 3) enable fallback to TLS1.2 compatibility mode? Thoughts?
Connor (infra): routing to backup region already has a runbook: `infra/traffic-shift` can direct 30-50% to us-west. But that doesn't help customers bound to EU compliance.
Miguel (svc-owner): re-uploading intermediate is quicker. I have a known-good intermediate in Vault from last rotation. We can push to the edge CA bundle, but need rollout steps: patch config -> restart ingress pods gradually.
Evan (SRE): steps if we re-upload:
- retrieve `secret/ca/eu/intermediate` from vault -> verify fingerprint
- patch configmap `edge-ca-bundle-eu` with base64 cert
- `kubectl rollout restart deployment/edge-proxy -n ingress` with maxUnavailable=1
- monitor `ssl_handshake_success` metric and errors.
Priya (oncall): assign tasks. Connor and Evan do the Vault retrieve + verify. Miguel to validate fingerprint and authorize. Julie to prepare customer comms and escalate P1 notices. I'll stay hands-on.
Connor (infra): retrieving now. running `vault read -field=cert secret/ca/eu/intermediate | sha256sum` -> `b4c1...f9a`.
Evan (SRE): confirming same fingerprint on our archival copy. checking expiry: `openssl x509 -noout -dates` -> `notAfter=Mar 24 2026` good.
Miguel (svc-owner): I authorize emergency upload. pushing to cluster in 2 min.
Priya (oncall): do a canary patch to one node first. Keep debug logs on.
Connor (infra): patched configmap on eu-edge-canary, restarted the canary pod. Monitoring logs...
Connor (infra): canary showing no more verify errors now. `ssl_handshake` errors dropped to 0.1% for that pod.
Evan (SRE): rolling to remaining pods in batches (maxUnavailable=2). Watching metrics: error_rate decreasing from 3.2% -> 0.4% over 8 minutes.
Julie (support): posting initial customer update: "We're aware of TLS handshake failures in EU causing 5xx errors. We have identified an expired intermediate cert and are applying a fix. Some customers may see transient errors as we roll the update. ETA 15-30m." will post once I have your ok.
Miguel (svc-owner): thumbs up to send. Please include RC & contact for P1s.
Priya (oncall): continue to monitor. Connor/Evan confirm full rollout status after last pod restarted. Also file an RCA ticket — we didn't have expiry alert on intermediate.
Evan (SRE): full rollout completed at 10:28 UTC. last_message_ts updated. metrics stable, no residual service errors for EU edge.
Priya (oncall): handoff to Evan for postmortem and follow-ups. I'm stepping off oncall in 20m. Thanks team. :thumbsup: 
Julie (support): customer updates sent, CS engaged for high-touch accounts.
Miguel (svc-owner): will open a PR to add intermediate expiry checks into the cert-monitoring job.
PagerDutyBot: Incident acknowledged and marked under investigation -> status: mitigated (partial) -> awaiting RCA.
